name: brewlite-monorepo
description: BrewLite – Requirements to Deployment (Next.js Mobile-first PWA, NestJS 3-Tier Modular Monolith, PostgreSQL Prisma ORM & Docker)

scripts.build: npm --workspace=apps/api run build && npm --workspace=apps/web run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace=apps/api run lint && npm --workspace=apps/web run lint
scripts.test: npm --workspace=apps/api run test && npm --workspace=apps/web run test
